kind: Question-first result-extent diagnosis with two separate seven-unit AI judgments

cases.original_question: Show the most recent meetings and their TDoc counts (meeting coverage check).
cases.original_query: MATCH (m:Meeting) WITH m OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m) WITH m, count(t) AS tdocs RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, tdocs ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, m.canonicalMeetingNumber LIMIT 5
cases.exact_missing_criterion: Number or temporal window of most recent meetings.
cases.evidence: Original English fixes meeting identities and TDoc counts but gives no k/window. The preserved Phase1 default-limit matrix enumerates CQ1–4; no CQ5-2 default is supplied. Holding the same58-record population, count unit and independently source-supported chronology fixed, conditional k5 and k10 have different memberships. Original LIMIT5, expected_min_rows5 and the alternative query-normative hierarchy are preserved as counterevidence.
cases.classification_scope: Current question-first semantic review policy, not a theorem that the original executable Cypher has multiple results.

opposing_interpretation.policy: Original reference Cypher is itself the normative specification.
opposing_interpretation.consequence: LIMIT5 and numeric order fix a query-defined task. Under this alternative hierarchy this is not missing result extent.

cases.recovery_condition: Bind and document the intended recent-window/number, then verify original-question semantics, source-supported order and complete-record scoring.
